method_return_type_corrections.evidence_source: A runtime probe on platforms 8.3.17.1549 and 8.3.27.2214 (server code, a factory built from an XML schema with one complex and one simple type, and the global ФабрикаXDTO): `ТипЗнч(Ф.Создать(<ТипОбъектаXDTO>))` is «Объект XDTO» and equals `Тип("ОбъектXDTO")`; `ТипЗнч(Ф.Создать(<ТипЗначенияXDTO>, "x"))` is «Значение XDTO»; `ФабрикаXDTO.Создать(ФабрикаXDTO.Тип("http://v8.1c.ru/8.1/data/core", "TypeDescription"))` is «Объект XDTO». The extracted record (method id 2070) lists the variant «Создание объекта» with a `ТипОбъектаXDTO` parameter but carries `return_type: ЗначениеXDTO` for every variant.
method_return_type_corrections.rationale: With `ЗначениеXDTO` alone every object created by the factory is typed as a value, and a write to a property of the object that is spelled like a property of ЗначениеXDTO (`Объект.Значение = …`, `Объект.Value = …`) is reported as ReadOnlyPropertyAssignment although the platform accepts it. The call returns one of the two types depending on the kind of its `Тип` argument, so the result is their union; a write to `Значение` of a value that is known to be a ЗначениеXDTO (an element of `Список`, for instance) is still reported.

type_member_surface_attestations.rationale: Without the attestation a member spelled wrongly on a description of an attribute is an unknown shape and reads silently. The extract lists the platform's own surface of the description at 8.3.27, its name carries none of the markers of a type a configuration extends (form, extension, data composition), and the live run answers a member outside it with an execution error, so a miss is a defect of the checked code. The corpus evidence has a stated limit: only chains whose receiver is provable from the text were counted (the attribute collection of a named object read by member), while the bulk of the real use is indirect, through a loop variable, `Найти` or an index of the collection (the collection is mentioned 5192 times in 36 configurations), and the zero misses say nothing about those. The decisive check is a run of the analyzer over whole configurations, which the entry's author does not replace by this count.

parameter_passing_attestations.evidence_source: Every parameter inside the attested scope was read in the pinned 8.3.27 corpus (PROVENANCE.md). 500 global functions declare 859 parameters at the top level and 194 more across call variants; the 23 variant-bearing functions of unverified_functions take 388 of those 1053 out, which leaves 665 parameters the attestation speaks for. Three passes judged them, and the claim rests on the third. (1) A net of write-back wordings over the descriptions. Its first form matched whole word forms and missed three of the records shipped beside this entry, because «возвращает» is not «возвращается» and «помещенный» is not «будет помещено»; widened to stems (возвраща, помещ, записыв, заполн, устанавл, присваив, выходн, сохран, получ) it leaves 140 descriptions to read by hand instead of 38. (2) A scan for a parameter named in angle brackets inside ANOTHER parameter's description beside a write-back verb, which catches an output documented only in a sibling's prose: 11 hits, of which 8 describe an input or a parameter of a callback, 2 reproduce the records of ПоместитьФайл, and 1 was new (УдалитьОбъекты «НайденныеДанные»). The strongest discriminator found in these two passes was neither wording nor cross-reference but the declared type: ПоместитьФайлы and ПолучитьФайлы each take ОписаниеПередаваемогоФайла in and give ОписаниеПереданногоФайла back, while the descriptions of the two parameters are nearly the same sentence. (3) A run of the analyzer over five working configurations, with the fact in place and without it. This is the pass that caught the error: of the 7279 findings the fact adds, 5021 are arguments of a call to an attested global function, spread over 128 distinct (function, parameter) pairs, and every pair was judged by hand; exactly one finding stood on a parameter the platform fills, ПоместитьФайлы «ПомещенныеФайлы», now recorded. Of the rest, 476 are arguments of calls this attestation does not reach — methods of a type and methods of the configuration, whose passing was already known — and 1782 are ordinary reads that follow from a suppression no longer taken. What no pass discharges: a parameter whose description says nothing about write-back, and which no call in those configurations passes a variable to, is claimed to be passed by value on the strength of its type and its prose alone. The arithmetic above is not left to prose — the_unverified_functions_are_exactly_the_global_functions_with_call_variants and the_passing_attestation_covers_every_parameter_outside_its_exclusion_list in tests/bundled_facts.rs hold the exclusion list and the coverage to the shipped corpus.
parameter_passing_attestations.rationale: A record says that one parameter is passed by reference; this attestation is what lets the absence of a record mean «passed by value» for the rest of the scope, which is the inference a rule about the origin of a value needs. The claim is deliberately narrower than the scope: for the 23 listed functions the extract does not document every parameter, so a consumer must treat their arguments as unknown rather than as passed by value. Without the exclusion list the same silence would read as proof, and a by-reference parameter hidden in an undocumented call variant would turn into a false finding.
